document cited below, under the manager's standing rule that whatever is
stated in our approved legal documents is the final position (recorded
2026-08-19). Ratified 2026-08-20 under the owner's coverage-gap tasking
It is CONFIGURATION: no all_lock.md entry, no locked decision amended.
PRESENCE Requirement: it verifies the provision EXISTS. The clause's CONTENT goes to Legal with the evidence — categorical value comparison is a V2 evaluator (CLAUSE_CATALOGUE.md).

Reads whether the no-early-termination restriction exists. The early-termination FEE FORMULA is deliberately not extracted as a numeric position: 'total fees that would have become payable for the remainder of the Term' is a formula, not a magnitude, and 45B.4 forbids flattening it into a comparable number.
description: The customer cannot end the agreement before the term expires, and owes the remaining fees if it does so without permission.
source_document: Leapswitch Master Services Agreement, Version 2 (July 2025) — MSA.pdf at LEGALMIND_SOURCE_MATERIAL_DIR
source_clause: 7.2 Restriction on Early Termination by Customer
source_quote: The Customer shall have no right to terminate this Agreement before the expiry of the Term. If the Customer elects to terminate this Agreement for any reason not expressly permitted under this Agreement, the Customer shall remain fully liable to pay Leapswitch an early termination fee equal to the total fees that would have become payable for the remainder of the Term

configuration.position_statement: No early exit is permitted from a fixed-term commitment without the applicable financial consequence.
waiver_patterns: early termination charges shall not apply
charges for the unexpired term shall not apply
not be liable for any early termination compensation
configuration.nli_hypothesis: If the customer ends the contract early, it must pay the fees for the rest of the term.
configuration._nli_hypothesis_note: AM-152: the local NLI tripwire's hypothesis only — a plain restatement of Constitution §14 (as the ratified description is), never shown as a position and never a counter-proposal. Measured 2026-10-16: waiver spans contradiction 0.98-0.99, LeapSwitch restriction entailment 0.99-1.00, unrelated neutral; the verbatim §14 sentence read every span as neutral (0.001), so it cannot serve as the tripwire's reference.
commitment_phrases: customer shall have no right to terminate this agreement before the expiry of the term
configuration._commitment_note: AM-161 r3/r4: a confirmed clause with a SENTENCE stating this phrase, with no waiver pattern in that sentence, is a fixed-term commitment (§14 Scope). Recognition terms (35.4), never a position. It names the restricted party: LeapSwitch's own 'no right to terminate' never commits the customer, and 'the remainder of the Term' also appears in waivers of the charge, so it is not one.

_legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- an absent provision included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal
Decision required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
